{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Check retraction status immediately, as an open notice forces a return regardless of compliance with every other provision including figure adjustments. Manuscript length requires at least twenty-two pages, where exactly that page count satisfies the requirement. Format demands either the official template or documentation evidencing three years of revision history, though submissions to Track D are exempt from this specific rule provided they carry exactly two endorsements rather than one; this exemption applies only to format and does not lift other constraints. Regarding venue history, a Tier-1 presentation renders a manuscript ineligible unless it occurred more than eighteen months prior to the deadline, with exactly that duration failing qualification. Prior round acceptances similarly bar submissions if fewer than five years have elapsed since that round, though exactly five years permits handling. Paired submissions must consist of exactly two manuscripts; both independently require length and format compliance, yet only one needs venue clearance. Figure counts range from eight to forty-five inclusive for standard entries, while pairs allow up to seventy figures with the same minimum threshold. A deficiency below the minimum results in a padded verdict rather than return, whereas exceeding the maximum mandates an immediate return. These figure rules operate independently of retraction notices which always supersede final disposition.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":3545311931,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
